narrative.overview: A dense, calm calling workspace built for scanning and follow-through. Neutral surfaces establish the work area while aubergine marks the selected or forward action.
keyCharacteristics: One sans-serif family and a five-step type scale.
Neutral tonal surfaces with precise borders.
A stable action vocabulary across every workspace.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.description: Do not introduce blue, green, or a second purple for normal actions.

rules.name: The Five-Step Type Rule
rules.description: New interface work uses only 10, 12, 14, 20, or 32px text.

rules.name: The Variant Rule
rules.description: New screens compose documented control roles before adding new visual treatments.

dos: Keep focus visible and labels explicit.
donts: Do not add green accents or decorative gradients.
Do not add raw color or size values where a token exists.
Do not change persisted internal names for a visual rebrand.
